name: flowcode
description: FlowCode — local-first, AI-native IDE with a governed multi-agent runtime

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/daemon && npm run build -w @flowcode/ui && npm run build -w @flowcode/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/daemon && npm run typecheck -w @flowcode/ui && npm run typecheck -w @flowcode/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @flowcode/desktop
